metadata.dataset: Official road kilometre markers, coastal Yucatan corridor
metadata.crs: EPSG:4326; GeoJSON coordinate order longitude, latitude
metadata.attribution: Fuente: INEGI / SICT-IMT, Red Nacional de Caminos 2025. Consulta del servicio IMT del 28 de octubre de 2026.
metadata.transformation_notice: Selection and road association by this project; not produced or endorsed by INEGI. Original marker coordinates, ids, km and dates preserved.
metadata.chainage_warning: Kilometres belong to their road chainage, not distance from Progreso or a continuous distance along the entire coast. Chainage origin was not published by the source layer and is not inferred.
metadata.quality_warning: Marker positions are approximate and update dates vary. Not verified in the field in this project.
metadata.road_association_method: Local equirectangular point-to-segment distance for matching only, <=25 m, rejecting different road name/code within nearest +3 m. No coordinate snapping and no derivation of official kilometre values.
